plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: Clouds of blush-white blossoms cover bare branches before any leaves appear. Petals drift down like confetti and carpet parks, riverbanks and temple grounds in pale pink.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late March to early April in Tokyo, with first blooms usually appearing around March 20 to 25
plants.location: Tokyo and the Kanto region, Japan
plants.funFact: Nearly every Yoshino cherry tree is a genetic clone, grafted from one original cultivar. That is why whole cities' trees bloom almost in unison.

plants.name: Narcissus pseudonarcissus
plants.description: Nodding trumpets of golden yellow sit inside paler, swept-back petals. Drifts of them light up woodland floors and meadows in early spring.
plants.location: Western Europe, including England, Wales and northern France
plants.funFact: Daffodil bulbs contain galanthamine, a compound that has been developed into a medicine for symptoms of Alzheimer's disease.

plants.name: Colchicum autumnale
plants.description: Goblet-shaped lilac-pink flowers rise from the ground without any leaves, a surprising sight in the southern autumn. Where it grows it is a favorite of late-season pollinators.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late summer to autumn in the Northern Hemisphere. In the Southern Hemisphere it is naturalized and flowers in autumn, around March to April
plants.location: Gardens in southern Australia, New Zealand and South Africa
plants.funFact: Despite the name, it is not a true crocus. Its flowers appear first and its leaves emerge months later in spring.
